intent: An Apple-grade settings screen for a journaling app: a large title that folds into a glass nav bar, grouped inset sections, physical switches, a gliding segmented control, a snapping slider with a value bubble, a row that expands in place and a glass confirm sheet.

stack.web: react-native-web compatible; animate opacity on the BlurView itself, not a parent

layout.nav: absolute, 54pt status + 44pt bar, Done pill on the right
layout.profile: 68pt avatar with gradient ring, name, email, plan pill, three-up stats strip
layout.groups: 26pt apart; 13pt uppercase header; radius-18 card; 52pt rows with 30pt tiles and inset hairline separators
sections: Reading: segmented paper, text size slider, live preview
Writing: reminder switch, expandable time row, prompts
Privacy & sync: Face ID, iCloud sync, Export
layout.sheet: inset 10pt, radius 34, icon disc, title, body, destructive and cancel buttons

color.background: #F2F1EE with peach #FBD3B8 and sage #CFE6DA radial washes

motion.navGlass: blur, wash and hairline fade in over the first 36pt of scroll; small title fades and rises 6pt between 30 and 48pt
motion.largeTitle: pull-down scales it to 1.12 from its left edge
motion.rowPress: 6% highlight in 90ms, out 320ms; tile springs to 0.9
motion.switch: knob spring 520/26 with one small landing; stretches to 33pt while held; fill fades in
motion.segmented: thumb spring 500/40, squeezes to 0.95 while held; preview papers crossfade 340ms
motion.slider: 1:1 drag, rubber-band past the ends, velocity-aware snap (420/30), 1.16 tick pulse, value bubble
motion.expand: measured height 380ms ease-out open / 260ms close, content fades and drops 8pt, chevron rotates 90°
motion.sheet: springs up 340/34, drag to dismiss, spinner then check with a 1.04 overshoot; counts tween to 0
motion.reducedMotion: no springs or scale; instant height; 120ms fades

responsive.width: 360–430pt; time chips align to the text column from 380pt and take the full row below that

accessibility: Switches use role switch with checked state; the whole row also toggles
Segmented control is a tablist with selected tabs
Slider is adjustable with min, max, now, a spoken value and increment/decrement actions
The expanding row reports expanded; the confirm button reports busy
The large title is a header; SVG icons are hidden

content.profile: Inês Marlowe, ines@marlowe.studio, Folio Plus renews 2 Mar, 412 entries, 38-day streak, 96k words
content.sample: Thursday, 9 October: Rain on the tram windows all the way to Graça…

avoid: A flat translucent grey nav bar
Rows that cut open instead of animating height
Opacity animated on a BlurView's parent
